text.en: Pet owners praise Dr Brendan and Ella for their genuine kindness, patience, and attentive bedside manner. Reviewers appreciate that the team gives clients ample time without rushing examinations. Clients consistently feel reassured by the personal care and clinical competence displayed during consultations.

title.en: Gentle approach with dogs and cats

text.en: Reviewers emphasize that puppies, elderly pets, and nervous animals are welcomed warmly and made to feel at home immediately. Clients note that examinations are conducted gently, keeping stress levels low. Pet parents appreciate the thoughtful attention paid to animal comfort across routine and post-surgical visits.

Clients highlight the clinics exceptional communication, noting that practitioners explain each diagnostic step and treatment option clearly. Reviewers appreciate that doctors patiently answer all questions and follow up before appointments. Non-native speakers also praise the team for explaining care plans at an accessible pace.

q.en: Are follow-up calls provided for recovering pets?

a.en: Yes, reviewers highlight that clinic staff proactively contact owners between visits to monitor their pets condition.
The practice is situated on Trees Road Upper in Mount Merrion, Blackrock, County Dublin.

q.en: What emergency care arrangements are available when the clinic is closed?

a.en: Out-of-hours veterinary emergencies are covered by the Pet Emergency Hospital at UCD.
Yes, clients can book consultations through the clinics online booking platform or by phoning reception.
